status.description: GREEN only when there are zero BLOCKER/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW findings. The render step re-derives this from the findings and never upgrades toward GREEN.

summary.description: 2-6 sentences: what was reviewed and the overall verdict.

id.description: Stable short id, e.g. F1, F2 — referenced by the remediation disposition.

severity.description: FALSE_POSITIVE = a concern you considered and dismissed yourself; record it so it is not re-raised. It does not count toward ISSUES_FOUND.

confidence.description: observed = reproduced or directly demonstrated in code; supported = strong code-level evidence, not executed; speculative = plausible but unverified.

evidence.description: File:line references, code excerpts, or command output that substantiates the finding.

test_to_prove.description: The test that would fail before the fix and pass after.
